input_text: To prove that the insured under a life policy is dead, his wife offers a death certificate.

extraction.input_text: To prove that the insured under a life policy is dead, his wife offers a death certificate.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The death certificate is a written document created outside of the current trial proceedings, satisfying the out-of-court requirement of FRE 801(c).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(2) - Hearsay requires a statement made out of court.

arguments.text: The death certificate contains a factual assertion regarding the death of the insured, satisfying the assertion requirement of FRE 801(c).
The certificate is explicitly offered to prove that the insured is dead, which matches the truth of the matter asserted in the document, satisfying the purpose requirement of FRE 801(c).
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c)(3) - Hearsay requires the statement be offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: To prove that the insured under a life policy is dead
